prompts.pause: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied PAUSE window sprite. Preserve the exact entire original panel, aspect ratio, border, gradient, typography, gear button, green RESUME, orange RESTART, red QUIT buttons and their positions, crisp edges. Change ONLY the two audio buttons: remove the middle blue speaker button AND its entire shadow, remove the right red musical-note button AND its entire shadow. Fill their old regions with uninterrupted matching blue panel gradient so we can place live independent sprite buttons in Unity. Keep left gear button untouched. Do not add any new buttons, icons, frames or text. Genuine transparent exterior, no glow outside the rounded panel border. Full complete border and corners. Do not crop, no layout changes, no wording changes, exact PAUSE / GAME PAUSED / RESUME / RESTART / QUIT text.
prompts.collection: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: standalone production Unity game UI sprite, blank collection window background. Input reference is the supplied blue fishing play/equipment panel. Match its EXACT clean illustrated style: royal blue to turquoise gradient interior, thin bright cyan double rounded border with dark navy outside edge, a few glossy bubbles near left corners, flowing green aquatic leaves limited to bottom corners, subtle wave along bottom. Render ONE complete rectangular panel, landscape ratio 1.5:1, centered with generous genuine transparent exterior padding on every edge. Large empty uninterrupted blue interior for live game grid and title. No cards, no icons, no words, no letters, no buttons. Same simple crisp toy-game shading, no wood, no rope, no brass, no ornate additions. Sharp high resolution, all four corners and complete border visible.
prompts.card: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: ONE standalone production Unity collection card background sprite. Style reference the white equipment cards on the supplied blue fishing play/equipment panel. ONE vertical card ratio 0.85 width to 1 height, gently rounded corners, thick softly beveled silver-white complete rim, white to very pale icy blue blank face, subtle dark navy outer outline and navy bottom shadow. Face completely blank so live fish or hooks and labels can be placed on top. No text, no fish, no hook, no button, no icons. Frontal flat orthographic clean crisp illustrated mobile game UI. Generous genuine transparent margin around ALL sides, no background, complete lower edge and rounded corners. High resolution.
prompts.dive: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: standalone vertical side-of-screen fishing HUD background for Unity. Reference supplied play/equipment panel style EXACTLY: royal blue/turquoise gradient, bright thin cyan double rounded rim, navy outer edge, glossy bubbles and flowing green leaves only at bottom corners, wavy cyan lower edge. ONE portrait panel ratio width 0.66 height 1. Centered complete panel with genuine transparent padding all sides. Inside top 20 percent leave blank blue for live phase text. At 25 to 70 percent height ONE blank silver-white rounded equipment card face, empty white space for live haul value and catch count. Bottom 75 to 94 percent height ONE glossy green blank rounded rectangular button with dark green/navy outline like equipment purchase buttons. All text will be live Unity text. No text, words, digits, fish icons, reel icon, equipment icons or wood/rope/brass. Simple crisp sharp exact mobile illustrated game style.
prompts.audio: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: four separate square audio button sprites in a 2 by 2 sprite sheet with WIDE empty transparent gutters, genuine transparent canvas. Reference supplied blue pause window style. Top left: blue rounded square glossy button with white speaker and sound waves, dark navy outline. Top right: EXACT matching blue speaker button muted, white speaker icon with a clear red diagonal slash across the icon; no waves. Bottom left: red rounded glossy square button with white musical eighth note, navy outline. Bottom right: EXACT matching red music note button muted, clear diagonal dark navy slash across note. Buttons equal sizes, aligned to grid, no overlap, no cropping. All four buttons fully visible with generous transparent margin around EACH sprite and no edge shadows in gutters. No letters, words or on/off text. Crisp high resolution toy mobile game UI.
